    Your AI sees everything.
    Make it see what matters.

    LeanCTX is the operating system for AI context. It decides what your AI sees, remembers, and focuses on — so every answer is faster, smarter, and more accurate. One binary, zero config, works with Cursor, Claude Code, Copilot, and 24+ tools.

    90+ 个 shell 命令模式自动压缩——git、npm、cargo、docker、kubectl

    Every file read, every shell command, every search result — your AI sends it all to the model without filtering. The result? Slower responses, higher costs, and an AI that loses focus in its own context window. "The bottleneck isn't the model. It's what you feed it."

    What is LeanCTX?

    A runtime that makes AI agents smarter.

    ctx_read 10 modes caching

    Sees Smarter

    Compresses files intelligently — keeping types, signatures, and logic while removing noise. Your AI reads 10x more code in the same context window.

    ctx_shell ctx_search 90+ patterns

    Remembers Better

    Cross-session memory, knowledge graphs, and context checkpoints. Your AI knows what happened yesterday, not just what's in the current prompt.

    profiles budgets governance

    Works Controlled

    Profiles, roles, budgets, and SLOs. Define how much context each agent uses, what tools they can access, and when to throttle.

    Four Dimensions of Context Intelligence

    Everything between your code and the AI, handled.

    01

    Intelligent Compression

    AST-based file parsing, 90+ shell patterns, entropy filtering. Your AI sees the signal, not the noise. 60-99% fewer tokens, same information.

    02

    Smart Routing

    Intent classification (What/How/Do), model tier recommendations, adaptive mode selection. The right context reaches the right model at the right time.

    03

    Persistent Memory

    Session continuity, knowledge graphs, context checkpoints. Your AI remembers discoveries, decisions, and context across conversations and agents.

    04

    Output Verification

    Path anchoring, identifier checking, structural integrity. Every compressed output is verified — no important information gets lost.

    60–99% 每次文件读取的 token 减少——缓存重新读取达到 99%，首次读取根据模式 60–95%
    49 个智能工具替换内置文件读取、shell 命令和代码搜索
    90+ 个 shell 命令模式自动压缩——git、npm、cargo、docker、kubectl
    0 需要的配置——安装、初始化、完成。适用于所有主要 AI 编码工具

    架构

    三个独立的上下文层。

    每一层独立运行。它们共同构成一个上下文管道，在信息到达LLM之前进行过滤、压缩、优先排序和翻译——将原始数据转化为结构化智能。

    上下文服务器

    49个智能工具取代内置的文件读取、Shell命令和代码搜索。理解你的意图，根据任务类型选择正确的压缩模式，监控上下文窗口压力，并管理跨会话记忆——一切自主运行。

    探索工具

    Shell Hook

    拦截 shell 输出并识别 90+ 命令模式——git、npm、cargo、docker、kubectl——全部自动压缩。

    查看模式

    协议

    三个协议——CEP（效率评分）、CCP（跨会话记忆）、TDD（符号缩写）——教 AI 更精简地通信。额外节省 8–25% 的 token。
